name: Pizza & Movie Night
notes: Let everyone build their own personal pizza while a movie plays.

name: Quesadillas & Smoothies
notes: Cheese quesadillas with a fruit-and-spinach smoothie — they can't taste the spinach.

name: Spaghetti & Hidden-Veggie Meatballs
notes: Shredded zucchini and carrot blended right into the meatballs.

name: Build-Your-Own Tacos
notes: Set out toppings so everyone builds their own plate.

name: Sheet-Pan Chicken & Roasted Veggies
notes: A drizzle of honey on the veggies wins over picky eaters.

name: Baked Ziti
notes: Pureed butternut squash stirred into the sauce — no one notices.

name: Teriyaki Chicken & Rice
notes: Adventurous-eater favorite. Try adding pineapple chunks.

name: Turkey Chili
notes: Finely diced bell pepper and carrot cook down until they disappear.

name: Creamy Mac & Cheese
notes: Butternut squash puree makes the sauce extra creamy (and sneaky).

name: Veggie-Loaded Meatloaf
notes: Grated carrot, zucchini, and onion mixed right in.

name: Breakfast for Dinner
notes: Pancakes, eggs, and fruit — a fun switch-up night.

name: Chicken Stir-Fry
notes: Adventurous pick — dice the veggies small for the picky eater.

name: Homemade Chicken Nuggets & Dip
notes: Serve with ranch and a side of veggies for dipping.

name: Backyard Burgers
notes: Grate zucchini into the patty mix for extra moisture (and veggies).

name: Veggie Fried Rice
notes: Finely chopped veggies mixed right into the rice.

name: Kid-Style Pasta Primavera
notes: Extra butter and parmesan on the veggies helps close the deal.

name: Grilled Cheese & Tomato Soup
notes: Blend the soup smooth — hidden veggies included.

name: Turkey Burgers
notes: A leaner take on burger night.

name: Chicken Parmesan
notes: Serve with a side of roasted broccoli "fries."

name: Breakfast Burritos
notes: Scrambled eggs, cheese, and finely diced peppers.

name: Shepherd's Pie
notes: Mashed cauliflower mixed into the potato topping.

name: BBQ Chicken & Corn
notes: A reliable crowd-pleaser for both kids.

name: Korean Beef Bowls
notes: Adventurous pick — mild spice, easy to dial down.

name: Sloppy Joes
notes: Grated carrot cooks right into the sauce.

name: Sushi Bake
notes: A fun adventurous-eater night — deconstructed sushi in a casserole dish.

name: Mild Chicken Curry & Rice
notes: Adventurous pick — coconut milk keeps it mild and creamy.

name: Veggie Lo Mein
notes: Noodles make the veggies an easy sell.

name: Pulled Pork Sliders
notes: Serve coleslaw on the side, or blend it into the sauce.

name: Orange Chicken & Rice
notes: Sweet enough for the picky eater, interesting enough for the adventurous one.

name: Sheet-Pan Chicken Fajitas
notes: Let everyone build their own — cut peppers extra small.
